name: Zenithal-Fjard
description: Rock deserts and sand seas take turns under a sky like hammered brass. Between dust events the wind redraws an orbital debris ring, patient as erosion itself.
Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it.
the quarantine zone changes hands often and quietly. Its current occupants trade fuel for silence and ask no questions about cargo.
Whoever controls rare flora controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
